test.description: THIS BOARD IS FOR TESTING KANBAI.

kanbai-from-scratch.description: A learning-first epic for understanding Kanbai end-to-end, documenting each subsystem, and creating refactor-friendly tutorials so future development is faster, clearer, and less token-intensive.

kanbai-app.description: Transition Kanbai from a gitops-first board into a stateful application that can be launched via Docker Compose, persist data in SQLite with cloud backup, and operate across multiple repositories simultaneously. The target architecture introduces repository-scoped epics, agent registration/deployment, a skills registry with both global and per-epic skills, and a path toward shared memory across epics while preserving clear delivery slices and migration safety.
